text.en:
The allowances of Medicare dependents be raised to the same level of allowances of contributing
members as provided for by Executive Order 949 last May 1, 1984.

There will be no corresponding increase in premium contributions, except the covered wage ceiling
which shall be raised to P1,000.00 effective January 1, 1987.

Presidential Decree No. 1519 and all laws, executive orders or parts thereof which are inconsistent
with the provisions of this order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 20th day of January, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
